name: Sharp GP2Y0A21YK0F IR distance sensor
description: Sharp infrared triangulation distance sensor, 10 to 80 cm, analog output: Vo falls from about 2.3 V at 10 cm to 0.4 V at 80 cm (typical, roughly linear in 1/distance) and rises to a 3.1 V peak near 6 cm before falling again. 4.5-5.5 V supply, 30 mA typical; a new reading every 38 ms. Sold as: Sharp GP2Y0A21YK0F (Pololu #136 / SparkFun SEN-00242) with a 3-pin JST PH cable such as Pololu #117 (male pins), connector order Vo, GND, VCC.
eli5: Shines invisible infrared light and sees where the reflection lands, so it can tell how far away something is (10 to 80 cm). The closer the object, the higher the voltage on its Vo wire.

pins.name: Vo
pins.description: Analog output (connector pin 1): about 2.3 V at 10 cm down to 0.4 V at 80 cm, peaks near 3.1 V, so safe for a 3.3 V ADC pin

pins.name: VCC
pins.description: Supply 4.5-5.5 V (connector pin 3), 30 mA typical. Use 5 V / VBUS; add 10 uF across VCC-GND near the sensor

supplierQuery: Sharp GP2Y0A21YK0F infrared distance sensor 10-80cm with JST cable
buildNotes: Connector order (datasheet): pin 1 Vo, pin 2 GND, pin 3 VCC. Cable colours vary between sellers, so follow the pin numbers marked on the sensor housing.
Power VCC from 5 V (USB 5V / VIN / VBUS): the sensor needs 4.5-5.5 V and does not work on 3.3 V.
Fit a 10 uF (or larger) capacitor between VCC and GND close to the sensor, as the datasheet recommends; the IR LED pulses otherwise show up as noise on Vo.
Vo stays below about 3.1 V, so it connects straight to an ESP32 ADC1 pin (GPIO32-39) or a Pico ADC pin (GP26-28) without a divider.
Keep objects at least 10 cm away: closer than that the voltage falls again and the reading looks like a larger distance.
The curve is typical only (80 cm output 0.25-0.55 V between units); check a few distances against a ruler if accuracy matters.

example.code:
from gp2y0a21yk import GP2Y0A21YK
import time

sensor = GP2Y0A21YK({VO})
while True:
    d = sensor.distance_cm()
    print('D=%s' % ('--' if d is None else '%.0fcm' % d))
    time.sleep_ms(200)

test.title: Converts the Vo voltage on the slider to distance with the datasheet curve (0.92 V = 30 cm)
